snippet.title: MR MAGPIES HARMLESS CARD GAME | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
The Minesweeper Deckbuilder. Use hints to deduce the location of evil JERRY cards. Stack the deck in your favor and exploit strange synergies to get filthy rich. Make your quota before closing time and He won't have to kill you!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3616280/Mr_Magpies_Harmless_Card_Game/

---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
